verdict.pick: Transparent Labs Grass‑Fed Whey Protein Isolate
verdict.line: Ideal for athletes who need a clean, high‑quality whey source. It offers a pure isolate with no added fillers, making it the only product here that guarantees 90 % whey protein by weight. The catch: it is unflavored, so you must add your own flavoring.
